data.body: Measured recovery (output, not target): net -3 src comment lines in reconciler subtree (11 files) — deliberately conservative per the corrected AC. Substantive relocations were MOVES not deletions: pagination-stall contract + 3 incidents (deac/9263/cabc) consolidated into new ADR 0062; cap-prose collapsed to See-ADR-0058 citations. Correctness fixes: false STUB header in _backend_registry.py corrected (select_backend live, 9 distinct modules/13 sites); stale S2/S3/S4-not-landed notes fixed. do_not_move list (~25 entries + 110 pragma lines) recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md. Gates: lint+typecheck clean; reconciler/backend tests 2578 passed. Change 1542.
